description: Scalable Brain Production & Development Monorepo Hierarchy

nodes.name: prod
nodes.description: Production execution directory containing running microservices, local SQLite databases, service supervisors, and operational log files.

subdirectories.name: services
subdirectories.description: PowerShell service automation (`sb_service.ps1`, `alwayson_elevated.ps1`) managing background daemons (publisher, telemetry-server, queue).

subdirectories.name: state
subdirectories.description: Active state databases: `ams.db` (System 3 risk gate & positions), `system2.db` (order execution facts), `notifications.db`, `shadow_incubator.db`.

subdirectories.name: logs
subdirectories.description: Rotated execution logs for publisher, supervisor, and System 3 AMS daemon.

subdirectories.name: repo
subdirectories.description: Git checkout of the production core systems (`systems/brain`, `systems/bridge`, `systems/guardian`).

nodes.name: scalablebrain-umbrella
nodes.description: Production deployment repository hosting the Layer 4 FastAPI Telemetry Server and Layer 5 React/Vite Telemetry Dashboard.

subdirectories.name: telemetry-server
subdirectories.description: FastAPI backend answering `/api/v1/*` routes (trades, risk, kpi, candles, decisions, currency-exposure), backed by Postgres with read-only SQLite fallbacks.

subdirectories.name: telemetry-dashboard
subdirectories.description: Vite/React frontend client with TradingView Lightweight Charts, 6-card trade inspector, real-time filters, and CAD risk toggles.

nodes.name: dev & dev-umbrella
nodes.description: Isolated development working trees for building and testing features before deployment to production.

nodes.name: data/artifacts
nodes.description: Permanent store for trained models, analytics bundles, hourly signal ledgers, and 30-second publisher snapshots.

subdirectories.name: signals
subdirectories.description: Hourly signal ledger NDJSON files grouped by date (`signals/YYYY-MM-DD/*.ndjson`).

nodes.name: Scalablebrainfullarchitecture
nodes.description: Central architecture hub, reading library, interactive ERD, and operations tracking portal.

nodes.name: control-panel
nodes.description: Independent operator console for pausing trading, manual resets, and health probes.
